prompt:
Redesign Cara's animation ASSETS for calm, delightful interaction. Use the supplied approved head as identity reference. Create ONE clean production sprite sheet of EXACTLY 24 frames in a strict 4-column by 6-row grid. Portrait aspect 2:3, ideally 1536x2304 or higher. All 24 cells equal-sized, NO labels or borders. EVERY cell has generous completely clear gutters: the character uses only 55 percent of cell width and at most 48 percent of cell height. Do not enlarge any head to fill its cell. Same center and baseline in every cell. Each full head is the SAME reusable outline stencil, same dimensions, same ink weight. No accidental head shape, scale or camera changes between states. Hand-drawn character through slightly organic contour quality, NOT frame-to-frame whole-head wobble.

IDENTITY: abstract ageless small head, warm ivory interior, dark blue ink #2455A6. Wide rounded pebble head with subtle side-swept top silhouette and a tiny outward flick at upper right. No separate interior hair strokes, no baby curl, no realistic human child, no ears, no nose, no neck/body, no hands. Tiny dot eyes and simple expressive eyebrows/mouth. Flat editorial pen line art. NO glows, halos, shading, gradients, colored artifacts, textures, shadows, or decorative marks outside the heads. Genuine transparent background and gutters, not a drawn checkerboard. Keep interiors solid ivory.

Frame positions, row-major:
ROW 1:
0 REST: calm small closed smile, relaxed eyes.
1 REST BLINK: exact same head and mouth as 0, eyes closed as short gentle curves.
2 LISTEN: head just slightly tilted/turned with eyes looking upward toward the speaker, eyebrows attentive, small closed smile. Like tilting an ear toward someone, still abstract.
3 LISTEN BLINK: exact same listening pose as 2, only eyes close.

ROW 2:
4 THINK: stable head, eyes slightly up-left, one softly raised brow, small thoughtful mouth.
5 DRAW / CONCENTRATE: focused eyes glancing slightly down to the work, a TINY TONGUE sticking out of one corner of the mouth. Tongue is a small rounded blue-outlined ivory shape, not red. Charming artist concentrating, never cheeky or mocking. No hands.
6 DRAW BLINK: identical head/mouth/tongue to frame 5, eyes briefly closed.
7 PLEASED: quiet satisfied smile, gentle relaxed brows, no exaggerated grin.

ROW 3:
8 DELIGHT: eyes smiling into arches with a warm open smile.
9 CURIOUS: one eyebrow raised, interested gaze, tiny neutral mouth.
10 PUZZLED: brows lightly gathered with uncertain tiny crooked mouth.
11 CONCERNED / RECOVERING: gentle apologetic brows and small mouth, reassuring not distressed.

ROW 4 — TALKING MOUTH DONORS:
12 small open mouth; 13 medium horizontal mouth; 14 round O mouth; 15 wider open smile. Use EXACTLY frame 0's head contour, eyes, eyebrows, facial placement, and ivory color in ALL FOUR. Only the mouth changes. These will be composited onto the fixed rest head. Keep every mouth inside the same small lower-middle face area. No teeth or tongue in these talking frames.

ROWS 5 and 6 — ONE-TIME SWIRL-TO-DRAWING REVEAL:
16 tiny central ink dot;
17 tiny loose central spiral;
18 larger central swirl opening outward;
19 swirl resolves into a half-drawn head outline;
20 completed head outline with ivory fill, no face yet;
21 eyes appear;
22 eyebrows and unfinished mouth stroke appear;
23 complete neutral head IDENTICAL TO FRAME 0.
All reveal frames share the final head's central registration point and scale. Early dots and swirls stay tiny in the middle of their otherwise empty cells; never zoom them up. The final four reveal outlines exactly reuse the neutral head stencil.

Composition priority: count 4 columns x6 rows exactly, large consistent gutters, identical registration and stroke weight, useful DISTINCT expressions, NO full-head looping differences. The character should feel like a patient, thoughtful little drawing companion, with personality in her facial expressions, not constant movement.
registration: scripts/build-cara-atlas.mjs packs onto one shared outline and keeps talking eyes byte-identical.
